question_cn: 西班牙开局兑换变中白方Bxc6制造黑方叠兵（dxc6或bxc6）。这个兑换的长期战略价值是什么？
question_en: In the Ruy Lopez Exchange Variation, what is the long-term value of Bxc6, which can give Black doubled c-pawns?

options.text_cn: 只是为了消灭一匹马，没有长期战略意义
options.text_en: It only removes a knight and has no long-term strategic purpose.

options.text_cn: 制造黑方c线叠兵——叠兵中有一个实际上是长期弱点，残局中白方兵型更健康
options.text_en: It gives Black doubled c-pawns, one of which may become a lasting weakness, while White retains a healthier pawn structure.

options.text_cn: 让黑方多一个兵控制中心，实际上对白方不利
options.text_en: It gives Black an extra pawn to control the center, which favors Black.

options.text_cn: 白方失去象，换来的只是暂时优势
options.text_en: White gives up the bishop for only a temporary advantage.

explanation_cn: Bxc6后黑方bxc6（或dxc6）形成叠兵：c线上两个兵叠在一起，其中一个无法正常保护另一个，残局中是长期结构弱点。白方用「象换马」的等价兑换换取了「健康兵型vs叠兵」的结构优势——这正是西班牙兑换变的核心战略。白方在残局中依靠兵型优势缓慢转化。兑换改变兵型是最常见的有价值兑换类型之一。
explanation_en: After Bxc6 and a pawn recapture, Black may have doubled pawns on the c-file, one of which can become a long-term weakness in the endgame. White trades a bishop for a knight but may gain a structural edge with a healthier pawn formation. Changing the pawn structure is one common strategic reason to exchange pieces.
